provider: Hi168 (上海海文) — S3-compatible object storage

free_tier.stated: 500 GB on registration, 1 TB after real-name verification (实名). Forum dealers advertised it as '免费领取1T超大对象存储' in Jan 2026; by 2026-01-19 nodeloc reported '新用户注册只有5G了，仅做留档' — i.e. the grant was already being clawed back.

tooling: Real S3 endpoint with AccessKey/SecretKey issued from the '存储管理' app inside their cloud desktop; works with rclone s3, s3cmd, aws-cli, OpenClaw. No named first-party client.
chaining: 1 TB per account after real-name. Bucket count per account unverified (the article shows bucket creation, count not stated). The only way the total grows is another account, and each one costs a 实名 identity — so this does NOT multiply for a user.
limits_note: per-object-cap unknown; throughput is the binding limit (2–4 MB/s up). Public bucket support unclear.
reliability_note: Quota already cut once (500 GB→1 TB deal shrank to 5 GB for new users within ~2 months of the Jan 2026 hype cycle). Domain intermittently timed out from outside CN.

evidence.proved: '注册后，会自动获得 500GB 存储空间，再经过实名制验证，就能得到 1TB'; tested 2–4 MB/s upload
